edges.reason: msg.sender is returned verbatim by the internal _msgSender helper, propagating caller control into every ERC20 entry point.
TNODE constructor mints the whole supply to msg.sender, so the deployer/caller receives 1e9 tokens.
_msgSender() supplies the from address used by transfer, giving the caller control of the debited account.
_msgSender() supplies the owner whose allowance is written by approve.
_msgSender() supplies the caller whose allowance is read and decremented in transferFrom.
_msgSender() supplies the allowance owner updated by increaseAllowance.
_msgSender() supplies the allowance owner updated by decreaseAllowance.
name_ constructor argument is assigned to the _name state variable.
symbol_ constructor argument is assigned to the _symbol state variable.
ERC20 constructor writes the immutable-in-practice _name state variable.
ERC20 constructor writes the immutable-in-practice _symbol state variable.
name() reads _name and returns it.
symbol() reads _symbol and returns it.
totalSupply() reads the _totalSupply state variable.
account parameter indexes the _balances mapping read in balanceOf.
balanceOf reads _balances[account].
recipient parameter is forwarded to _transfer by transfer.
amount parameter is forwarded to _transfer by transfer.
owner parameter indexes the _allowances mapping read in allowance.
spender parameter indexes the _allowances mapping read in allowance.
allowance reads _allowances[owner][spender].
spender parameter is forwarded to _approve by approve.
amount parameter is forwarded to _approve by approve.
sender parameter is forwarded to the internal _transfer call.
recipient parameter is forwarded to the internal _transfer call.
amount parameter is forwarded to _transfer and used in the allowance subtraction.
spender parameter identifies the allowance entry modified by increaseAllowance.
addedValue parameter is added to the current allowance prior to _approve.
spender parameter identifies the allowance entry modified by decreaseAllowance.
subtractedValue parameter is compared and subtracted from the current allowance.
sender parameter selects the debited balance entry in _transfer.
recipient parameter selects the credited balance entry in _transfer.
amount parameter drives the balance checks and the unchecked debit in _transfer.
account parameter selects the credited balance entry in _mint.
amount parameter increases _totalSupply and the account balance in _mint.
account parameter selects the debited balance entry in _burn.
amount parameter drives the unchecked debit and total supply reduction in _burn.
owner parameter is the outer key written into _allowances.
spender parameter is the inner key written into _allowances.
amount parameter is the allowance value written into _allowances.
from argument passed into the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
to argument passed into the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
amount argument passed into the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
from argument passed into the _afterTokenTransfer hook.
to argument passed into the _afterTokenTransfer hook.
amount argument passed into the _afterTokenTransfer hook.
transfer delegates all balance movement to the internal _transfer routine.
approve delegates the allowance write to the internal _approve routine.
transferFrom first moves tokens through the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom writes the reduced allowance through _approve inside an unchecked block.
increaseAllowance writes the increased allowance through _approve.
decreaseAllowance writes the reduced allowance through _approve.
TNODE constructor invokes the internal _mint to create the initial supply.
_transfer debits the sender entry and credits the recipient entry of _balances.
_mint credits _balances[account] with the minted amount.
_mint increases the _totalSupply state variable.
_burn debits _balances[account] by the burned amount.
_burn decreases the _totalSupply state variable.
_approve writes _allowances[owner][spender].
_transfer calls the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before updating balances, an extension point that can re-enter the token flow.
_transfer calls the overridable _afterTokenTransfer hook after updating balances, an extension point that can re-enter the token flow.
_mint invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before minting state changes.
_mint invokes the overridable _afterTokenTransfer hook after minting state changes.
_burn invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before burning state changes.
_burn invokes the overridable _afterTokenTransfer hook after burning state changes.
transferFrom reads _allowances[sender][_msgSender()] into the currentAllowance local variable.
currentAllowance is the left operand of the unchecked subtraction.
the user-supplied amount is the right operand of the unchecked allowance subtraction.
the unchecked subtraction result is written back to the allowance via _approve.
decreaseAllowance reads _allowances[_msgSender()][spender] into the currentAllowance local variable.
currentAllowance is the left operand of the unchecked subtraction.
the user-supplied subtractedValue is the right operand of the unchecked allowance subtraction.
the unchecked subtraction result is written back to the allowance via _approve.
_transfer reads _balances[sender] into the senderBalance local variable.
senderBalance is the left operand of the unchecked debit subtraction.
the user-supplied amount is the right operand of the unchecked balance subtraction.
the unchecked subtraction result is written to _balances[sender].
_burn reads _balances[account] into the accountBalance local variable.
accountBalance is the left operand of the unchecked burn subtraction.
the user-supplied amount is the right operand of the unchecked burn subtraction.
the unchecked subtraction result is written to _balances[account].
